author: [deleted]
body:
Clean your inventory more is all you can do. Put stuff in your keep that you don’t want to delete, but don’t need immediately. Try to get down to like 2 pages of inventory for each category and then it’s good, in my experience.

I’ve brought this up over the years and the devs basically say it’s Apples fault. I still don’t buy that, but I think the devs aren’t spending time on this issue because they don’t think they can fix it.
